title: 把工作邮件写短：怎样做到简洁又完整
topic: 把工作邮件写短：怎样做到简洁又完整

source.title: Learn how brevity in writing can lead to clarity of meaning - Dropbox
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 原文出自 Dropbox 公开资料。
paragraphs: Ideally, sentences should have fewer than 15 words. This improves clarity. Force your brain to think this way by pretending you’re out of breath. When you’re struggling to catch your breath, you only say what matters. Brevity begins as a state of mind.

Write your request as you normally would. Make sure that you’ve provided enough information for others to loop themselves in. Now, cut the last line and paste it at the top. 9 times out of 10, this simple act will bring your ask up front. You may need to tweak the line or gently reframe the lines after, but this abrupt switch will rewire your brain to think about the bottom line first and list it up front. Humans are storytellers. We love character development, story arcs, and punch lines. We’re used to setting things up and then delivering the real news. Brevity requires you to think differently — and do the opposite.

Actively avoid words which weaken your point. Use hard figures instead of roundabouts like “nearly” or “almost.” If you spot an adverb, remove it. (Example: replace “increased massively” with “added 400 new members.”) To avoid doing this manually, paste your communication into online editor tools and consider their recommendations (be mindful of your organization’s policies and remove any confidential information).
translations: 理想情况下，句子应少于15个单词。这提高了清晰度。通过假装你上气不接下气来强迫你的大脑这样思考。当你努力喘息时，你只说重要的事情。简洁始于一种心态。

像平常一样写你的请求。确保你已提供足够的信息让其他人能够参与进来。现在，删掉最后一行并将其粘贴到顶部。十分之九的情况下，这个简单的行为会让你的请求前置。你可能需要调整这一行或温和地重新调整后面的行，但这种突然的转换会重新连接你的大脑，让你首先考虑底线并将其列在前面。人类是讲故事的人。我们喜欢人物发展、故事情节和笑点。我们习惯于先铺垫，然后传达真正的信息。简洁要求你以不同的方式思考——并做相反的事情。
积极避免削弱你观点的词语。使用具体数字而不是"几乎"或"差不多"这样的模糊表达。如果你发现副词，就删除它。（例如：将"大幅增加"替换为"增加了400名新成员"。）为了避免手动操作，将你的沟通内容粘贴到在线编辑工具中，并考虑它们的建议（注意你组织的政策，并删除任何机密信息）。

notes.phrase: sentences should have fewer than 15 words
notes.explain: 保持句子简短有助于提高清晰度，让读者更容易理解信息
notes.example: To improve readability, ensure your sentences have fewer than 15 words.

notes.phrase: cut the last line and paste it at the top
notes.meaning: 删除最后一行并将其粘贴到顶部
notes.explain: 这是一种写作技巧，通过将最重要的信息前置，帮助读者快速抓住重点
notes.example: To make your email more effective, cut the last line and paste it at the top.

notes.meaning: 人类是天生的讲故事者
notes.explain: 人们习惯于按故事结构组织信息，先铺垫再揭示重点，而简洁写作要求打破这种习惯
notes.example: Humans are storytellers by nature, but business writing requires a different approach.

notes.phrase: Actively avoid words which weaken your point
notes.meaning: 主动避免削弱你观点的词语
notes.explain: 在职场沟通中，应使用直接、有力的表达，避免模糊或弱化信息的词汇
notes.example: To strengthen your argument, actively avoid words which weaken your point.

scenario.title: Shortening Work Emails
english: Sarah needed to inform her team about a project deadline change while also requesting additional resources.
Her manager emphasized brevity in emails, while team members needed clear context to adjust their schedules.
She applied the principle of cutting unnecessary words and starting with the most critical information.
chinese: 莎拉需要通知团队项目截止日期变更，同时请求额外资源支持。
她的经理强调邮件要简洁，而团队成员需要清晰背景来调整工作安排。
她运用了删减不必要词汇、从最关键信息开始沟通的原则。

firstAttempt.prompt: 客户把项目截止日期提前到下周五。你需要团队本周增加一位评审人。请用两句英文写一封简短邮件：先说明日期变化，再提出支持请求并请对方确认。
firstAttempt.sample: The client moved the deadline to next Friday. Could we add another reviewer this week to meet the new timeline? Could you confirm who is available by 3 p.m. today?
firstAttempt.rationale: 先说日期变化，再提出具体支持请求并说明何时需要答复。

words.example: Brevity helps readers find the main point quickly.
words.translation: 简洁有助于读者快速找到重点。
words.note: 在职场写作中，简洁性往往比冗长的解释更有效

words.collocation: loop someone in on the discussion
words.example: Please loop the design team in if the new deadline changes their workload.
words.translation: 如果新截止时间会影响设计团队的工作量，请把他们也拉进沟通。
words.note: loop someone in 表示让某人加入讨论并同步信息。

words.example: I’ll tweak the email to state the new deadline and request in two sentences.
words.translation: 我会把邮件改成两句话，写清新截止时间和请求。
words.note: 表示对细节进行小幅度调整，使表达更精确

words.example: Regular practice can rewire your writing habits over time.
words.translation: 持续练习可以逐渐改变你的写作习惯。
words.note: 选学词：rewire 常用于“重新塑造习惯”的比喻表达，不是本期核心邮件句型。

words.example: Avoid roundabout expressions; state the new deadline first.
words.translation: 避免绕弯表达，先写新的截止时间。
words.note: roundabout 在这里作形容词，描述表达迂回。

words.example: Remove unnecessary adverbs to make the email more concise.
words.translation: 删去不必要的副词，让邮件更简洁。
words.note: 副词常会使表达变得冗长，在简洁写作中应谨慎使用

structure.original: Make sure that you’ve provided enough information for others to loop themselves in.
analysis: Make sure that 是一个祈使句的引导短语，后面接一个宾语从句 that you've provided enough information
that you've provided enough information 是一个宾语从句，其中 you've provided 是现在完成时态，enough information 是动词 provided 的直接宾语
for others to loop themselves in 是一个不定式短语作目的状语，其中 for others 表示动作的接受者，to loop themselves in 是不定式结构，loop oneself in 是一个固定搭配，表示'让某人加入讨论或项目'
structure.transfer: Ensure that you've included sufficient details for your team to catch up quickly.

rewrite.bad: I am writing to inform you that the deadline has changed and we need more resources to complete everything.
rewrite.good: The client moved the deadline to next Friday. Could we add support this week to meet the new timeline?
rewrite.translation: 客户把截止日期提前到下周五。我们能否本周增加一些支持，赶上新的时间安排？
rewrite.pattern: The client moved [the deadline]. Could we [ask for specific support] to meet [the new date]?

cloze.prompt: I’m writing to ___ the revised delivery date.
cloze.why: 目的前置，读者不用从长段背景中猜邮件重点。

cloze.prompt: The new date, owner, and customer impact are ___ below.
cloze.why: 按主题组织信息，让读者更快扫描。

cloze.prompt: Please ___ the date by 3 p.m. tomorrow.
cloze.why: 结尾直接写动作和时间，避免请求被埋在正文里。

dictation.text: Sarah needed to inform her team about a project deadline change while also requesting additional resources.
dictation.why: 听清句中的工作任务、动作和时间信息。

dictation.text: Her manager emphasized brevity in emails, while team members needed clear context to adjust their schedules.
dictation.why: 听清句中的工作任务、动作和时间信息。

translationPractice.prompt: 客户把截止日期提前到了下周五。
translationPractice.answer: The client moved the deadline to next Friday.
translationPractice.why: 直接用第一句交代日期变化。

translationPractice.prompt: 你能在今天下午三点前确认谁有空吗？
translationPractice.answer: Could you confirm who is available by 3 p.m. today?
translationPractice.why: 明确请求对方在截止时间前答复。

choice.prompt: 客户把项目截止日期提前到下周五。请用英文写一封简短邮件，说明日期变化并请求团队增加支持。
options: I am writing to inform you that the project deadline has been changed to next Friday because the client requested it earlier, and we will need more resources to complete the work on time.
The client moved the deadline to next Friday. Could we add support this week to meet the new timeline?
The client moved the deadline to next Friday.
choice.why: 先说最重要的变化，再提出明确请求；删去“我写信是想告诉你”这类铺垫。

output.prompt: 数据团队告知你，周报中的客户留存数据要晚一天才能确认。请用两句英文通知经理：说明变化、影响和你建议的处理方式，并请对方确认。
output.sample: The retention figures will be ready one day later than planned, so I recommend sending the report with verified numbers on Thursday. Could you confirm this change by 3 p.m.?
check: 是否先说明数据延迟及其对周报的影响？
是否提出了清楚的处理建议？
是否请对方在明确时间前确认？

credits.audio: 美式英语合成朗读，非公司员工原声。

taskPhrases.word: The client moved the deadline to…
taskPhrases.meaning: 第一句交代最重要的变化
taskPhrases.collocation: move the deadline to + 日期
taskPhrases.example: The client moved the deadline to next Friday.
taskPhrases.translation: 客户把截止日期提前到了下周五。

taskPhrases.collocation: Could we add + support / reviewer + 时间?
taskPhrases.example: Could we add another reviewer this week to meet the new timeline?
taskPhrases.translation: 我们能否在本周增加一位评审人，以赶上新的时间安排？

taskPhrases.collocation: confirm + who / when + 完整句子
taskPhrases.example: Could you confirm who is available by 3 p.m. today?
taskPhrases.translation: 你能在今天下午三点前确认谁有空吗？
